'''Reflections Booster Draft''' is a Star Wars CCG booster-draft format played with [[Reflections]] packs. [[Decipher]] ran it as a sanctioned side event at [[DecipherCon 2000]], listed a ''Reflections II Booster Draft Format'' among its tournament formats in 2001, and the [[Players Committee]] keeps a Reflections Booster Draft in its Alternate Format Tournament Guide.<ref name="dcon-sw-events">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game events], DecipherCon 2000, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010126213800/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="res-sw">[http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Star Wars Customizable Card Game Tournament Resources], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011116144130/http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' booster draft
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (2000); Players Committee (Alternate Format Tournament Guide)
* '''Card pool:''' DecipherCon 2000: 3 Reflections boosters and a Darth Vader or Luke Skywalker [[Enhanced Premiere]] pack per player. Players Committee: 4 Reflections, Reflections II or Reflections III boosters
* '''In use:''' 2000 –
* '''Also called:''' Reflections Sealed Booster Draft (Decipher's DecipherCon 2000 schedule);<ref name="dcon00-sched">[http://www2.decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swccgevents.pdf DecipherCon Master Tournament Schedule for Decipher Games], DecipherCon 2000, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030413152501/http://www2.decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swccgevents.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> Reflections II Booster Draft Format (Decipher, 2001);<ref name="res-sw" /> Reflections II Booster Draft and Reflections III Booster Draft (Players Committee)<ref name="afg" />
* '''GEMP:''' none. [[Reflections Sealed]] on play.swccg.com is a sealed (not drafted) Reflections product.

== Card pool ==
=== Decipher (2000) ===
"Players will be seated into groups of 4, with each player receiving 3 Star Wars Reflections boosters and either a Darth Vader or Luke Skywalker Enhanced Premiere pack to draft the best decks possible. Will you draft the foil, or let it go?"<ref name="dcon-sw-events" />

Decipher's ''Reflections II Booster Draft Format'' page was linked from its 2001 tournament resources, but every preserved capture of that page is an error page, so its rules are unknown.<ref name="res-sw" />

=== Players Committee ===
The Alternate Format Tournament Guide requires 4 Reflections, Reflections II or Reflections III booster packs per player, played under its booster-draft rules. "Each player may bring with them six battleground locations that may be included in the player's deck. The Tournament Director should verify these locations' status as battlegrounds prior to beginning the tournament."<ref name="afg" /> Under those rules players draft in groups of 4 or 6, Light and Dark seated alternately, take one card of their own side from each pack and pass, and build a 40-card deck in 10 minutes.<ref name="afg" />

== History ==
At DecipherCon 2000 Decipher scheduled the Reflections Booster Draft on Thursday 5 October at 6 p.m. (event #SW213) and Friday 6 October at 9 a.m. (event #SW221), four games each, entry $20, sanctioned.<ref name="dcon-sw-events" /><ref name="dcon00-sched" />
